rationale: Class 3 anchor triangulation shows the B01 leaf-count flag is not a real fair-value coverage failure. The extracted position fair-value sum is 2,845.623249 million and the filing schedule total is 2,845.622 million, a difference of only 0.001249 million (0.000044%). Raw schedule rows display fair value for actual investments, including table 11 rows 5-7, while structural, heading, and continuation rows are also present in the schedule. The 322/686 leaf ratio therefore uses an inflated non-position leaf denominator rather than measuring missing fair value on positions. Residual risk is limited to the separate 1.249-thousand aggregate excess, which is immaterial to this coverage adjudication and may relate to the Constellation row structure at table 19 row 22.
